Company: Karma8 Location: Remote (Moscow timezone, UTC+3) Type: Full-time Compensation: from $2500/month

Russian-speaking team

Karma8 builds S3-compatible object storage for high-throughput workloads (AI, video, large-scale systems).

Tech stack: Vanilla JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, HTML/CSS, Git

What you’ll do: – Build and optimize high-load interfaces – Work on dashboards, UI components, internal tools – Improve existing codebase (no rewrites)

Requirements: – Strong JS/CSS/HTML fundamentals – Experience with jQuery, Bootstrap, Git – Performance mindset, cross-browser, HTTP basics – Experience with high-load or large-scale systems

We intentionally use vanilla JS (no frameworks).

Contact: Telegram: @teamchat_hr
